name: Lanthanum
occurrence: The most abundant of the rare-earth elements, found in monazite and bastnäsite ores.
majorUses: Nickel-metal-hydride (NiMH) battery alloys (notably in hybrid car batteries)
Camera and telescope lens glass (high refractive index)
notableCharacteristics: Gives its name to the entire lanthanide series, even though it technically has zero electrons in an f-orbital itself, sitting just before the f-block truly begins filling.
whyHere: Lanthanum's name comes from the Greek 'lanthanein', 'to lie hidden', because it was found concealed within a cerium sample — a fitting origin for the element that lends the entire hidden f-block series its name.
didYouKnow: A single Toyota Prius battery pack has historically contained several kilograms of lanthanum, making hybrid-car demand a real driver of rare-earth mining.
genZNote: Named 'the hidden one' and now hides inside literally every hybrid car battery. Still on brand.
